title: Fully retimed (FRO) DR8 is the baseline; LRO qualified per part number
rationale: No published 224G RTLR spec, so LRO interop depends on each host SerDes. dr8sim (500 m, 4 dB, Condor host): retimed passes with large margin; LRO is marginal against Broadcom's 1.5e-6 pre-FEC criterion and needs host-matched driver peaking. LRO saves ~8 W per module if it qualifies (pricing on Drive).

title: Arista 64PRS-RV3-L primary; Nexthop NH-4220-F backup for lead time
options: Arista 7060XE7-64PRS-RV3-L (liquid, ORv3 DC) / Nexthop NH-4220-F (air, AC) / other TH6 ODM boxes
rationale: Arista has the deepest engagement (design work, optics roadmap, LRO support) and a liquid-cooled ORv3 box that fits our racks, but it is a roadmap product (EFT Q4'26, GA Q1'27). Nexthop's TH6 box is already shipping to hyperscalers, is engineered for LRO, and runs SONiC. Gaps: air-cooled/AC only, IHS heat sink, 2DR4 own optics. Both use the same TH6 Condor SerDes, so optics qual data largely carries across.
